items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling game prop atlas. Generate one landscape transparent PNG, 1536x1024, a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid of six separate cutout objects. Subject: six DIFFERENT low ground clusters: pebbles with two ferns, shelf mushroom stump, broken mining timber with moss, tangled dry roots and river stones, small grass and porous limestone, abandoned rope coil and tiny clay pot. Palette and setting: damp blue-grey limestone cave, moss olive green, small pale shelf mushrooms, brittle roots. Painterly detailed dark fantasy realism, orthographic SIDE ELEVATION, no perspective floor plane. Each cluster is broad and LOW, occupies at most 85% width and 65% height of its 512x512 cell, centered, rests on the same horizontal baseline 450px into each row. All six objects completely separate with ample transparent gutters. Truly transparent alpha background throughout negative space, no checkerboard pattern baked in, no shadow rectangle, no ground slab, no backdrop, no text or labels or border, no bright neon. Designed as small pass-through ground dressing, not treasure or interactable items. Distinct asymmetric silhouettes, fine natural materials, consistent soft cool overhead light.
